test.description: Desk tests read repository files outside this package, so those files are inputs too (issue #490): the PR template (ship), ci-pr.yml (changeset rule), the issue templates and docs/agents/issue-format.md (contract), .github/repo-setup.json (agent label definitions), docs/agents/day-one.md (snapshot fixture), the root package.json (image context), commitlint.config.mjs and the script it imports (commit messages), and the .ai/ permissions, skills, agents, review, and hooks files that role prompts, permissions, and the opt-in DESK_LIVE suite load (issue #516).
